description:
Goal
Make native lowering treat omitted runtime layouts as authoritative, so ignored-return executables and continuations do not demand nonexistent semantic value bindings.

Problem being fixed
The reusable-cons continuation fixture exposed a broader native data-model bug. The minimal repro is still:

fn ping(x), do: x

fn rebuild(xs) do
  [h | t] = xs
  ping(0)
  [h | t]
end

fn main(), do: rebuild([1, 2])

Concrete repro
cargo test compiler2_native_program_transports_reusable_cons_caps_through_delivered_continuations --lib

Original failure
panic: native lowering referenced unbound value 0 for root 0

Actual root cause
The model does not become wrong in lowered/body or backend artifacts. The key facts are correct:
- `ping/1` is lowered as a semantic body that returns its input `ValueId(0)`
- the only live callsite ignores that return
- runtime demand therefore settles `ping/1` to `return_demand = Ignore`, `return_layout = Omitted`, and `runtime_params.inputs[0] = Omitted`

That is coherent. The bug was in native lowering: `return_carrier_var` and delivered-value encoding still tried to look up and encode the semantic return value even when the settled runtime layout was `Omitted`. That reintroduced a semantic-value obligation after the runtime contract had already said “carry no lanes.”

The same stale assumption also existed in the reusable-cons continuation test, which expected one delivered resume lane from `ping/1` even though the ignored result should deliver zero lanes.

Design decision
Fix this in native’s env-to-layout seam. Omitted layouts carry no lanes and therefore must not require a bound semantic local. Keep the semantic body unchanged; runtime representation is determined by the settled layout.

Code seams
- src/compiler2/jobs/native.rs `return_carrier_var`
- src/compiler2/jobs/native.rs delivered resume arg encoding
- src/compiler2/drive_test.rs reusable-cons continuation proof

Checks
- cargo test compiler2_native_program_transports_reusable_cons_caps_through_delivered_continuations --lib
- cargo test compiler2_native_program_matches_tuple_field_call_continuations_to_the_callee_return_abi --lib
- cargo test compiler2_interp_runs_quicksort_from_backend_artifacts --lib
title: Compiler2 native reusable-cons return-carrier drops a bound structural value
